Quick triage notes (ops):
- We observed a sustained increase in KV cache miss rate for v3-canary on the serving pool attached to DataScout (node group ds-us-west-2-a). Miss rate jumped from ~4% baseline to ~28% starting at ~08:36. This increased token decode work per request and amplified p99.
- Batching behavior: continuous-batching showed larger batch sizes for a subset of long-sequence requests; latency-sensitive short requests got queued behind longer ones in the canary routing config.
- Error rate: 5xx rose from 0.07% to 0.6% for text-gen route; root cause appears performance-resource interaction, not model crash.
- Actions taken: throttled canary traffic to 5% at 09:45 PT; rolling rollback ready if customer requests — I can flip traffic back to v2.3 immediately.
- Attachments: short stack traces and sample request IDs (customer_error_samples.txt).

Recommendation: rollback canary for DataScout to v2.3 while we investigate KV cache warming and batching policy mismatch. Postmortem required.

Hannah
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
